articles.title: KPDCL Says Bill Sahuliyat Plus App Functional, Attributes Update Glitch to Kimbal Smart Meters - Kashmir Life
articles.full_text:
SRINAGAR: The Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has clarified that its Bill Sahuliyat Plus mobile application is functioning normally, stating that problems with daily meter consumption and bill updates are limited to consumers using Kimbal-manufactured smart meters.
The clarification follows a news report titled “Bill Sahuliyat App Partially Down Since Nov 8”.
According to KPDCL, the issue is linked to a technical glitch in the Head End System (HES) of Kimbal, which collects meter readings and transmits them to the billing system. The affected meters, installed and maintained by TKC Anvil Energies, are functioning properly and continuing to record electricity consumption.
However, due to the communication failure, daily meter readings are not reaching the billing system, resulting in consumption details and electricity bills not being updated or reflected on the Bill Sahuliyat Plus application.
KPDCL said its technical team was working in close coordination with Anvil Meters and Kimbal to resolve the issue, adding that normal functioning was expected to be restored within a few days.
The corporation has also assured affected consumers that their electricity connections will not be disconnected until the issue is resolved. It said consumers would be given sufficient time to clear their dues once the bills are generated.
KPDCL regretted the inconvenience caused and thanked consumers for their patience and cooperation.
